column1: # gc_unmapped_store_baseline.tsv -- the PER-WITNESS ratchet of the unmapped-store class (cto, row
# `util_gc_unmapped_store_census.py <witnesses> --write-baseline <this file>` in the landing that earns a move.
# ONE LINE PER WITNESS AND NEVER A TOTAL, on hq_snobol4's measurement of 2026-09-20: the population is a
# directory glob, so nine witnesses arriving would move a total from 162 to 192 and the arm would print THE
# CLASS GREW and name a compiler regression it never measured.  A witness ARRIVING is a file addition; a
# witness's own numbers MOVING is the thing this row exists to catch, and only a name set can tell them apart.
# THE FIFTH COLUMN IS THIS CENSUS'S OWN REACH (cto 2026-09-20): stores shielded at a safe point into a
# FIXED SYMBOL rather than into the frame.  It is ratcheted because shielding MOVING from the graded road
# to the unread one is a loss of coverage that every other number here reads as an improvement.

# RE-CUT 2026-09-24 cto, SCRIP this landing (the seventeen-red row, class B): 56 rows MOVED with shielded and unread_static UP everywhere and members unchanged -- since af1d0e856 every C call from emitted code writes r8/r10/r11 into the fixed symbol rtccb around the call (the RTX ABI's writebacks), which this census counts as stores shielded into a fixed symbol; the five polls landed the same day add record stores below the swept floor. Neither is a store that lost its map (members=0 on every moved row before and after). Four witness rows are NEW (hb_match_enter_subject_polled, hb_defer_close_after_a_deferred_capture_polled, hb_match_value_close_polled, hb_size_result_polled), the reach witnesses of the five polls; the population is the gate's own (icn, sno, pl, raku).
